text: Jika huruf-huruf kata “kasur” dibaca terbalik, kata apa yang muncul?
gloss: If the letters of "kasur" (mattress) are read backwards, what word appears? — "rusak" (broken): k-a-s-u-r reversed is r-u-s-a-k.

text: Pukul “setengah tiga” sama dengan pukul berapa?
gloss: What time is "setengah tiga" (lit. half three)? — 02.30: Indonesian counts the half hour toward the next hour, so it is half past two, not half past three.

text: Kata “sapu” diberi awalan me- menjadi kata kerja ….
gloss: The word "sapu" (broom) with the prefix me- becomes the verb... — "menyapu": the initial s drops out and ny takes its place.

text: Kata mana yang bisa berarti makanan dari kedelai sekaligus “mengerti”?
gloss: Which word can mean a soybean food and also "to know"? — "tahu": tofu, and the verb "to know" (spelled the same).

text: Ibu berkata kepada tetangga, “Kami ke pasar dulu, ya.” Siapa yang pergi ke pasar?
gloss: A mother tells a neighbour "Kami ke pasar dulu". Who goes to the market? — Mother and her family without the neighbour: "kami" excludes the person addressed, "kita" includes them.

text: Dina menabung Rp2.000, lalu Rp4.000, Rp8.000, dan seterusnya. Berapa tabungan hari kelima?
gloss: Dina saves Rp2,000, then 4,000, 8,000 and so on. What is the fifth day? — Rp32,000: the amount doubles each day.

text: Rendang, daging berbumbu santan dan rempah yang dimasak lama, berasal dari suku ….
gloss: Rendang, meat slow-cooked in coconut milk and spices, comes from the ... people — Minangkabau of West Sumatra.

text: Danau Toba terletak di provinsi ….
gloss: Lake Toba lies in the province of — North Sumatra.

text: Tari Saman, yang ditarikan sambil duduk berbaris dan bertepuk serempak, berasal dari provinsi ….
gloss: The Saman dance, performed seated in a row with synchronised clapping, comes from the province of — Aceh (the Gayo people).

text: Ketupat Lebaran dianyam dari daun muda pohon kelapa yang disebut ….
gloss: Lebaran ketupat is woven from the young leaf of the coconut palm called — janur.

text: Buah berduri beraroma tajam apa yang dijuluki “raja buah”?
gloss: Which spiky, strong-smelling fruit is nicknamed the "king of fruits"? — durian (mangosteen is the "queen").

text: Dalam legenda Jawa, siapakah Ratu Laut Selatan?
gloss: In Javanese legend, who is the Queen of the Southern Sea? — Nyi Roro Kidul.

text: Lengkapi peribahasa: “Berakit-rakit ke hulu, berenang-renang ke ….”
gloss: Complete the proverb "Rafting upstream, swimming to the ..." — tepian (the bank): hardship first, pleasure later.

text: Di WhatsApp, apa arti dua centang biru di samping pesan yang kamu kirim?
gloss: In WhatsApp, what do two blue ticks beside a sent message mean? — the message has been read.

text: Kode OTP yang dikirim bank lewat SMS dirancang untuk dipakai berapa kali?
gloss: A one-time password sent by the bank is meant to be used how many times? — once only.

text: Membocorkan akhir cerita film kepada orang yang belum menonton disebut memberi ….
gloss: Revealing a film ending to someone who has not seen it is giving a — spoiler.

text: Minuman teh susu dengan bola tapioka kenyal, populer dengan nama boba, berasal dari ….
gloss: Boba, milk tea with chewy tapioca pearls, comes from — Taiwan (1980s).

text: Dalam permainan catur, bidak mana yang boleh melompati bidak lain?
gloss: In chess, which piece may jump over other pieces? — the knight (kuda, "horse").

text: Di tiket pesawat, kode bandara DPS menuju ke ….
gloss: On a flight ticket, the airport code DPS goes to — Bali (Denpasar).

text: Benda apa yang tidak boleh dimasukkan ke microwave karena bisa memicu percikan api?
gloss: What must not go in a microwave because it can spark? — a metal fork (metal reflects microwaves and sparks).

text: Apa keunggulan satu kode QRIS yang ditempel di warung?
options: Bisa dibayar lewat bank atau dompet digital mana pun
gloss: What is the advantage of a single QRIS code at a stall? — customers can pay through any bank or e-wallet app (QRIS is a unified standard).

text: Permintaan penonton agar penyanyi menyanyikan lagu tambahan di akhir konser disebut ….
gloss: At a concert, the audience call for extra songs at the end is called an — encore.

text: Dalam bola voli, satu tim boleh menyentuh bola paling banyak berapa kali sebelum bola melewati net?
gloss: In volleyball, a team may touch the ball at most how many times before it crosses the net? — three (a block does not count).

text: Upin dan Ipin tinggal bersama Opah dan kakak mereka, yaitu ….
gloss: Upin and Ipin live with Opah and their older sister — Kak Ros.

text: Dewa petir bermartil Mjölnir dalam mitologi Nordik adalah ….
gloss: The Norse thunder god with the hammer Mjölnir is — Thor.

text: Saat bepergian ke luar negeri, dokumen apa yang dicap oleh petugas imigrasi?
gloss: When travelling abroad, which document does the immigration officer stamp? — The passport.

text: Pada keyboard komputer, tombol Caps Lock mengubah huruf menjadi ….
gloss: On a computer keyboard, Caps Lock switches letters to — capitals.

text: Dalam bulu tangkis, apa nama pukulan keras yang menukik tajam dari atas kepala?
gloss: In badminton, what is the hard, steeply downward overhead shot called? — The smash.

text: Berapa selisih lama antara satu dasawarsa dan satu windu?
gloss: What is the difference between a dasawarsa and a windu? — 2 years: a dasawarsa is 10 years, a windu is 8.

text: Hari ini pasarannya Pon. Pasaran apa lima hari lagi?
gloss: Today the Javanese market day is Pon. What is it five days on? — Pon again: the five pasaran (Legi, Pahing, Pon, Wage, Kliwon) cycle every five days.

text: Pantun biasa bersajak a-b-a-b. Baris keempatnya berima dengan baris ke ….
options: Tidak berima dengan baris mana pun
gloss: A pantun usually rhymes a-b-a-b. The fourth line rhymes with line — the second.

text: Kumpulan surat R.A. Kartini terbit dengan judul “Habis Gelap Terbitlah ….”
gloss: R.A. Kartini collected letters are titled "After Darkness Comes ..." — Light (Terang).

text: Atap rumah gadang Minangkabau yang melengkung runcing menyerupai tanduk hewan apa?
gloss: The curved, pointed roof of the Minangkabau rumah gadang resembles the horns of which animal? — the buffalo.

text: Pemindai barcode di kasir membaca garis-garis hitam-putihnya dengan bantuan ….
gloss: A supermarket barcode scanner reads the black and white bars with the help of — light.

text: Golongan darah mana yang dikenal sebagai donor universal?
gloss: Which blood group is the universal donor? — O.

text: Jarak lari maraton resmi adalah ….
gloss: The official marathon distance is — 42.195 km.

text: Satu byte terdiri atas 8 bit. Berapa nilai berbeda yang bisa disimpan satu byte?
gloss: One byte is 8 bits. How many different values can it hold? — 256 (2^8); 255 is only the highest value.

text: Rasa pedas cabai terutama berasal dari zat ….
gloss: The heat of chilli peppers comes mainly from the compound — capsaicin.

text: Kompleks candi Angkor Wat terletak di negara ….
gloss: The Angkor Wat temple complex lies in — Cambodia.

text: Dalam serial dan manga “One Piece”, Luffy bercita-cita menjadi Raja ….
gloss: In "One Piece", Luffy dreams of becoming King of the — Pirates.

text: Serial “Squid Game”, tontonan viral di seluruh dunia, berasal dari negara ….
gloss: The series "Squid Game", a worldwide viral hit, comes from — South Korea.

text: Piala Dunia sepak bola 2022 di Qatar dimenangkan oleh tim nasional ….
gloss: The 2022 football World Cup in Qatar was won by — Argentina.

text: Dibandingkan tahun lalu, awal Ramadan tahun ini jatuh pada tanggal Masehi yang ….
gloss: Compared with last year, Ramadan this year starts on a Gregorian date that is — about 11 days earlier: the lunar Hijri year is about 11 days shorter than the solar year.

text: Selat yang memisahkan Pulau Sumatra dari Semenanjung Malaysia adalah Selat ….
gloss: The strait separating Sumatra from the Malay Peninsula is the Strait of — Malacca.

text: Satuan frekuensi, hertz (Hz), dinamai dari fisikawan ….
gloss: The unit of frequency, the hertz, is named after the physicist — Heinrich Hertz.

text: Situs ibu kota Majapahit, Trowulan, terletak di provinsi ….
gloss: The site of the Majapahit capital, Trowulan, lies in the province of — East Java.

text: Siapa pencipta lagu keroncong “Bengawan Solo”?
gloss: Who composed the keroncong song "Bengawan Solo"? — Gesang.

text: Candi utama Prambanan, yang tertinggi di kompleks itu, dipersembahkan kepada dewa ….
gloss: The main, tallest temple of Prambanan is dedicated to the god — Shiva (the flanking temples are Vishnu and Brahma).

text: Tim Berners-Lee mengusulkan World Wide Web pada 1989 saat bekerja di lembaga riset ….
gloss: Tim Berners-Lee proposed the World Wide Web in 1989 while working at the research institute — CERN.

text: Multatuli, penulis “Max Havelaar” yang mengkritik tanam paksa, bernama asli ….
gloss: Multatuli, author of "Max Havelaar", which criticised the cultivation system, was born — Eduard Douwes Dekker.
